label: BLOCK 01
prompt:
DURATION: 15 SECONDS
FORMAT: HORIZONTAL 16:9

Create a live-action cinematic supernatural scene in three shots.
The physical scale of the action is powerful and heightened,
while bodies, clothing, hair and camera movement remain tactile.

L01: 00:00–00:04.
L02: 00:04–00:10.
L03: 00:10–00:15.

This block ends with both women STILL SUSPENDED.
Their descent belongs to the following block.


CHARACTER REFERENCES

Zahhak: {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}
Shahrnaz: {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
Arnavaz: {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}

Preserve each character’s exact identity, costume, hairstyle,
body proportions and sculptural mask.

The sisters’ real eyes remain visible through the existing
mask openings.

Their masks are rigid objects secured to their heads.
Mask contours and eye openings retain their exact geometry.
Eye movement takes place behind these fixed openings.

Preserve the existing stone dust on Arnavaz’s left garment
and her slightly lowered left shoulder.

Zahhak’s living shoulder serpents maintain independent movement:
muscular neck flexion, small head turns and bodies sliding
against his costume.
Each serpent has one head and one continuous elongated body.


ANIMAL REFERENCE

Shahrnaz’s cat: {{ANIMAL_CAT}}

Preserve the animal’s exact appearance and size.
Shahrnaz holds it against her chest throughout.

Her left forearm supports its abdomen and hindquarters.
Her right hand supports its chest.
Its body remains sheltered between her forearms and torso.
Its ears draw back; its paws press against her clothing.


PROP REFERENCE

Serpent-headed staff: {{PROP_STAFF}}

Preserve its exact design and proportions.
The carved head is a rigid, inanimate object.

Zahhak holds the staff in his RIGHT hand.
His left hand remains beside his body.


LOCATION, FLOOR AND LIGHT

An interior space swallowed by darkness.

Optional lighting reference:
[ASSIGN AN APPROVED BLACK-BACKGROUND SPOTLIGHT FRAME]

Relight the referenced characters and props according to this scene.

The floor is a single continuous, perfectly level architectural
surface with a smooth matte charcoal finish.

It extends uninterrupted in every direction into darkness.
The characters stand directly on this common floor plane.
The visible surface has a fine, even texture and uniform elevation.

One fixed, hard, cold-neutral overhead spotlight illuminates
the three characters and part of this flat floor.

The illuminated floor area is ONLY a patch of light:
its boundary is a change in illumination on the same continuous
surface, with zero physical thickness or raised edge.

During levitation, the space between the women’s feet and this
flat floor is visibly empty.

Everything outside the light falls into solid black.
The surrounding architecture remains concealed.

Keep the spotlight’s direction, intensity and color fixed.
Keep exposure locked.
Its illuminated volume extends above the women’s suspended heads.

The force is visible through physical movement of bodies,
hair and fabric in clear air.


FIXED BLOCKING

For every shot, Zahhak remains SCREEN LEFT, facing SCREEN RIGHT.

The sisters remain SCREEN RIGHT, facing SCREEN LEFT toward him.

Shahrnaz stands nearer the camera at CENTER-RIGHT.
Arnavaz stands 80 centimeters farther from the camera
and 45 centimeters farther to SCREEN RIGHT.

Their silhouettes remain separated and individually readable.

Zahhak stands approximately 1.5 meters from Shahrnaz.
His staff acts toward the midpoint between the two women.

Both women rise directly above their original footprints.
Their horizontal spacing and orientation remain unchanged.

Every camera stays on the same side of the action axis.


SHOT L01 — THE FORCE GATHERS
00:00–00:04

40mm low three-quarter side view.
Camera approximately 90 centimeters above the flat floor.
Include all three characters, their feet and generous headroom.

Zahhak is left, facing right.
Shahrnaz is nearer center-right, facing left, holding the cat.
Arnavaz is deeper and farther right, facing left.

Use restrained handheld movement.

00:00–00:02:
Zahhak slowly raises his right forearm.
The carved staff head approaches the sisters’ eye level.
His torso stays grounded and almost still.

00:02–00:04:
Both sisters catch their breath simultaneously.
Their chins lift.
Their real eyes rotate upward behind their rigid masks.

A concentrated upward airflow builds around both women.
Loose hair lifts visibly away from necks and shoulders.
Free garment panels pull outward, then strain upward.

Arnavaz’s empty fingers spread involuntarily.
Shahrnaz braces the cat against her chest.

Both women remain standing directly on the smooth flat floor
until the cut.


SHOT L02 — THE ASCENT
00:04–00:10

Cut to a 28mm wide low-angle view from the same side.
Camera approximately 45 centimeters above the floor.

Show Zahhak full-length on the left and both sisters full-length
on the right.

Keep the flat floor beneath their feet visible.
Allow enough headroom for a 1.2-meter ascent.

00:04–00:05:
Zahhak makes one short, decisive upward movement with the staff.

Both women are pulled vertically upward together,
reaching 1.2 meters above the floor within approximately one second.

Their upper torsos lead the movement.
Their legs trail beneath them with a small physical delay.
Their feet leave the floor passively.
Their knees stay loose and their toes angle downward.

The camera reacts with one sharp handheld jolt and a quick
upward tilt, then recovers a readable wide composition.

00:05–00:10:
Hold both women at the same suspended height.

Their entire bodies and the empty gap beneath their feet
remain visible above the uninterrupted flat floor.

A strong upward, circulating airflow drives their loose clothing.
Long panels snap outward, curl around the legs, fall partially,
then lift again in irregular forceful pulses.

Hair streams upward and sideways.
Loose strands whip across the fixed edges of their masks.

Their torsos remain oriented toward Zahhak.
Their bodies stay suspended over their original footprints.

Arnavaz’s hands tremble beside her hips.
Her shoulders briefly contract.

Shahrnaz maintains a protective hold around the cat.
Her shoulders and knees shudder while her supporting arms
remain secure.

Zahhak stays grounded at screen left.
His small controlled gesture contrasts with the violent movement
of fabric and hair around the women.


SHOT L03 — HELD IN THE AIR
00:10–00:15

Cut to a 50mm tighter low-angle composition from the same side.

Zahhak occupies the LEFT foreground in rear three-quarter view,
facing right.
His right forearm and raised staff remain readable.

Shahrnaz occupies CENTER-RIGHT, nearer the camera.
Arnavaz occupies the deeper RIGHT position.

Frame the sisters from their dangling feet to above their heads.
Keep a narrow portion of the flat floor visible below them.

Make a slow handheld advance of approximately 20 centimeters,
as if cautiously approaching the suspended bodies.

Both women remain 1.2 meters above the floor.

A fresh pulse of air pulls their hair upward and drives the
loose garment panels sharply across and around their legs.

The cat’s exposed fur ripples while its body stays protected
against Shahrnaz’s chest.

Arnavaz’s empty fingers contract and release once.
Both women’s breathing remains strained.

Zahhak holds the staff at the same raised angle.
His living serpents continue small muscular movements.

End with both women suspended, the wind active,
and the staff still raised.

The final frame remains inside the scene, ready for a direct cut
into the next block.


SOUND

Close breaths catching.
A sudden rush of displaced air at the ascent.
Strong irregular cloth flutter.
Loose garment panels snapping in the airflow.
Faint grip tension from Zahhak’s staff.
Strained breathing beneath the wind.

Carry the airflow continuously through the final frame.

NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

Revision — the previous attempt was rejected for these reasons. Fix them:
- Both of them stand side-by-side in a straight line. From the camera's perspective: Arnavaz is on the right, and Shahnaz is on the left of Arnavaz. Shahnaz is holding the cat in her arms. Ensure their alignment side-by-side along this single plane is precise.

Established requirements for this subject:
- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.

<<<image_1>>> is Zahhak (CHR-001 V08); match it wherever Zahhak appears.
<<<image_2>>> is Arnavaz (CHR-004 V01); match it wherever Arnavaz appears.
<<<image_3>>> is Shahrnaz (CHR-005 V01); match it wherever Shahrnaz appears.
<<<image_4>>> is Cat Persian Longhair (CRT-004 V01); match it wherever Cat Persian Longhair appears.
<<<image_5>>> is Dagger Horse Head (PRP-019 V02); match it wherever Dagger Horse Head appears.
<<<image_6>>> is Staff - Bronze Cobra (PRP-001 V01); match it wherever Staff - Bronze Cobra appears.
